linear_family_only.decision: Restrict the model catalogue to the linear family (LinearRegression, Ridge, Lasso).
linear_family_only.rationale: Team decision favouring transparent, defensible, coefficient-interpretable models for a managerial audience; the catalogue stays extensible so ensembles can be added later.

split_early_test_untouched.decision: Split into train/validation/test early; the test split is untouched until a single final evaluation of the champion.
split_early_test_untouched.rationale: Professor's explicit doctrine; prevents optimistic bias and information leakage into model selection.

median_imputation_after_split.decision: Impute missing total_bedrooms with the median fitted on the training split only, after the split.
median_imputation_after_split.rationale: Prevents leakage of validation/test information into the imputation statistic.

tune_on_validation_not_kfold.decision: Tune Ridge/Lasso alpha on the dedicated validation split rather than k-fold cross-validation over train+validation.
tune_on_validation_not_kfold.rationale: Respects the professor's train/validation/test doctrine; keeps selection and final testing strictly separated.

governed_approvals_gate_training.decision: Training refuses any model not present in model_approval.json; features not approved are excluded from the modelling matrix.
governed_approvals_gate_training.rationale: Enforces the approval workflow so only governed, human-approved artifacts reach production.
